what.value: Let an agent park its own REPL turn until expected bellbacks/jobs return, then self-resume via the futon3c turn/execution path
what.quote: **Repo:** futon3c — the turn/execution path: `transport/http.clj` (`invoke-executor`, `handle-bell`, autobell-back, async-accept), `agency/turn_queue.clj` (durable per-agent queue + drainer-v2), `agents/tickle*` (self-trigger), `agency/clock_lineage.clj` (durable per-agent state precedent).
